# Tychon quantum sensing

> Source and evidence for synthetic ODMR simulation, scalar and vector field estimation, and FPGA control with replayed input. No live diamond sensor is demonstrated.

## Start here

- [Project overview](README.md): scope, representative results, and repository layout.
- [Reviewer guide](docs/start-here-reviewers.md): a 20-minute path through reproduction, results, and limitations.
- [Repository map](AGENTS.md): component paths, available commands, and evidence boundaries.
- [Case study](docs/case-study.md): results, limits, and project history.
- [Engineering decisions](docs/engineering-decisions.md): a withdrawn comparison, watchdog correction, and loss ablation.

## Reproduction and evidence

- [CPU benchmark](bench/README.md): synthetic scalar benchmark, prerequisites, reference results, and tolerances. A local run creates bench/results.json.
- [Benchmark configuration](bench/expected.json): expected metrics and tolerances, not a fresh run log.
- [Benchmark runs](https://github.com/jasonphillip/tychon-quantum-sensing/actions/workflows/bench.yml): execution logs tied to individual commits.
- [Test commands](.github/workflows/tests.yml): dependencies and per-component test invocations.
- [Deployed scalar model on the kit](workers/odmr-edge-ml/docs/deployed_model_on_kit_2026-10.md): dataset recipe, model contract, stage comparisons, synthetic-label errors, and kit timing.
- [Kit run artifacts](https://github.com/jasonphillip/polarfire-agent-skills/tree/53acad6/evidence/2026-10-14-deployed-fcnn): separate repository evidence for the deployed scalar model run.
- [Vector loss ablation](workers/odmr-vector-tracking/docs/association_loss_multiseed.md): matched training seeds, synthetic results, and remaining lock failures.
- [Simulator comparison with measured data](workers/nv-sensor-sim/docs/external_validation_results.md): discrepancies between default simulation and measured spectra.
- [Simulator fit](workers/nv-sensor-sim/docs/simulator_fit_results.md): in-sample fitting; not held-out estimator validation.

## Components and context

- [Simulator](workers/nv-sensor-sim/): synthetic spectra and datasets.
- [Scalar machine learning](workers/odmr-edge-ml/): training, evaluation, and export.
- [Vector tracking](workers/odmr-vector-tracking/): sequence estimators and evaluation.
- [FPGA control](workers/polarfire-hybrid-control/): design, firmware, and board checks.
- [Claim-checking workbench](orchestrator/README.md): local critic workflow and its measured limits.
- [Historical audits](orchestrator/tvw/audits/): reviews and dispatch records, separate from implementation evidence.
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md): terms and units.
- [Citation](CITATION.cff): release and DOI metadata; later commits may differ from the archived release.
